_doc: Tùng Đào Cung, part 2: Trúc Cơ (inner disciples, stewards, true disciples). World-depth pass, sect writer.

people.role: The head's last disciple (age 90), a healer at the Pill Room's second furnace
people.appearance: A soft-spoken young man with a ferryman's sunburn that never fades and herb stains up to the wrist.
people.backstory: Đàm Thanh Giang was born in 1110 in Cổ Độ Thành into the ferry family the head came from, the line of Đàm Tùng Lại's (dam_tung_lai) brother. At six he was sent up to the palace with a water gourd and a letter, and the head took him as his last disciple. He has no taste for fighting. Bồ Hạnh Lâm (bo_hanh_lam) taught him the furnace, and he now brews most of the wound pills the Coiled Root Hall uses, which is the only reason Nhiếp Cô Tân (nhiep_co_tan) is civil to him. He is ninety, at the last stage of Trúc Cơ, and in no hurry. Since 1190 he has flown out each autumn, most of a season's flight, to spend the winter on the islets of the Cold Ford's river mouth gathering a frost-root that grows only there, and every winter he has met a Thúy Vi girl there, Hướng Vãn Chu (huong_van_chu), who is trying to grow spirit rice in salt water. He has told nobody. The palace would see a scandal. Nhiếp would see a road across the ice.
people.wants: To brew a pill that mends a cracked foundation, and to stand on the ice one winter without having to leave at dawn.
people.secret: Since 1190 he has brewed the Coiled Root Hall's winter wound pills one grade weak, so that no patrol he heals can hold out a night on the river-mouth ice where he meets Hướng Vãn Chu; Nhiếp Cô Tân thinks the frost-root is poor.

ties.note: his master, of his own family's line
Thúy Vi's coast girl; every winter on the river-mouth ice since 1190
taught him the furnace
his senior under Đàm; he covers for her late nights
the ferry captain at Cổ Độ
works the first furnace and teases him about his frost-roots
she thinks the head's line is soft, and him softest

tree.intent: Wood heals and poison resistance toward the healer's notables; he keeps others standing.
tree.targets_note: Pine Strength first (its poison resistance is half his intent), then the herb notables Forest Floor, Herb Seed, Spirit Grass and New Leaf: a healer who keeps others standing and brews.

build.note: The head's humble disciple who would rather tend herbs and pills than fight: a healer's canon, a furnace gourd.

people.changed: gear ho_lo grade 2 -> td-ferryman-gourd (the same gourd, named); tree targets -> intent; birthplace added (61); root, thien_phu and stage moved to the top level

people.role: True disciple of the Coiled Root Hall and Nhiếp Cô Tân's granddaughter; the inner gate's best duellist
people.appearance: A tall, sharp-faced young woman in a patrolman's short coat, with a black flying blade across her back that was her father's.
people.backstory: Nhiếp Vãn Đào was born in the palace in 1166. When she was eight, Lạc Hà sent her father's blade back from the Ngư Ca border without him (A202), and her grandfather Nhiếp Cô Tân (nhiep_co_tan) raised her himself in the Coiled Root Hall. She formed her foundation at thirty-two and was made a true disciple at thirty-four, the youngest of her generation, and she has won every duel the inner gate has offered her. Her grandfather raised her to be head, and in 1199 Đàm named his quiet disciple Vi Thanh Âm (vi_thanh_am) instead. Vãn Đào took it better than the Root Hall did: she will not go with its searchers into the heir's rooms. She is not her grandfather. She has sat over the toll books with Từ Tích Cốc (tu_tich_coc) to learn what a war costs, and she walks the dikes with the flood wardens. She thinks the sect has a right to the Cold Ford. She has not yet decided whether it has a right to call six dead men deserters.
people.wants: Her father's name sung in the war roll with the bridges he cut, and any war the sect fights fought in the open.
people.secret: She found her grandfather's patrol order of 1172 among his things: the only written order the Coiled Root Hall has sent out in a century, because it had to cross the river. It carries his seal and not the head's. She has not told him, and she has not burned it.

ties.note: her grandfather and master, who raised her from eight
her father, dead on the Ngư Ca bridges
the governor's great-grandson
the named heir; she will not search her rooms
the head's soft last disciple
a drinker who will not say why
taught her what a war costs

tree.intent: Wood damage and crit through the flying-sword notables, then roots: she wants a duel over fast.
tree.targets_note: Pine route, then the Bamboo Joints crits and Autumn Maple: a Wood duellist who ends it fast; the flying sword is her blade, not her tree.

build.note: A flying blade, a palm, and the canon at its third layer.

people.role: Keeper of the spoken chronicle in the Hall of Voices
people.appearance: A thin, bald man with a voice much deeper than his body, who moves his lips while he listens.
people.backstory: Born in Tùng Phong Thôn, where the villagers learned to sleep through Vạn Hác's zither students (A056), he keeps the spoken chronicle of Tùng Đào: every event since the founding, sung in order, which takes him nine days. Hồ Tùng Nguyệt (ho_tung_nguyet) chose him for it. He sings the six patrolmen of 1172 as deserters because the roll says so, and he sings Lộ Thu Hà's (lo_thu_ha) nightly name after them because she asked. He has seen the ink on Vi Thanh Âm's (vi_thanh_am) hand and said nothing.
people.wants: To sing the whole chronicle once and find a successor who will not leave a night out.
people.secret: He is adding a private verse about the sleepers of Tùng Phong to the chronicle's nine days, and no one has noticed it yet.

ties.note: he has seen her ink
he sings her son's name
the second voice of the spoken chronicle, learning it from Sử Trường Ngâm

tree.targets_note: Pine route, then Hollow Bamboo: soul resistance and cheap Wood arts for the chronicle-keeper.

people.role: Steward of the outer gate at Tùng Hạ Thị; keeper of the inner gate's Wood test
people.appearance: A brisk woman with a pine-cone hairpin and a voice that carries across a whole yard without being raised.
people.backstory: Steward of the outer gate at Tùng Hạ Thị, she teaches the Listening Pine Primer line by line to a hundred children a year and decides which of them sit the inner gate's Wood test. Her own steward walked Vi Thanh Âm (vi_thanh_am) up to the palace in 1048, and she tells the story to every new class. She has noticed that the woodcutter's boy Trình Văn Thanh (trinh_van_thanh) repeats the pines' sound, not her words, and she has told the first elder.
people.wants: To have Trình Văn Thanh heard by someone who can use him before the Root Hall hears of him first.
people.secret: She teaches the outer gate's children a second primer in rhymes of her own because the first bores them, which the first elder would call writing.

ties.note: the boy who hears the pines
says the Wood test is wrong
the newest outer disciple, from Thanh Tùng Thôn
chants the primer to the outer gate at Tùng Hạ Thị, line by line
weaves the undyed pine-bark linen for the outer gate (servant)

tree.targets_note: Pine route, then New Growth and Spreading Canopy: a teacher's regeneration and healing.

people.role: Patrolman of the Coiled Root Hall; the seventh man of 1172
people.appearance: A heavy, quiet man with a drinker's red nose, a patrolman's token he never takes off, and a new bruise every week from things that fall on him.
people.backstory: He was the seventh man of the 1172 patrol. He had a fever the night the six went onto the Cold Ford ice, stayed in the reed camp, and heard Địch Kinh Lâm (dich_kinh_lam) read the order aloud to them: it carried the Coiled Root Hall's seal and no word of the head's. When the six were sung into the roll as deserters (N-thuy_vi-11) he said nothing. He has drunk most nights since.
people.wants: To get through one dusk listening sober and say what he heard.
people.secret: Once a month he sends Thôi Khinh Hồng a drunken letter by Yến Thu Hồng's tea-boy, telling what the order in the reed camp said.

ties.note: read the order aloud
his tent-mate; he lent him his coat for the ice and kept the fever
he owes her what he heard
she drinks with him and asks nothing, yet
Coiled Root Hall patrolman; rode the relief to the river-mouth ice in 1172

tree.targets_note: Pine route, then the Thorn Hedge idea: health, block and thorns for a palm that answers; his captain's line.

people.role: Coiled Root Hall patrolman
people.appearance: Talks at cattle-pen pitch even indoors, so the whole mess knows when he is coming.
people.backstory: A cattle boy from Phong Sào Thôn on Lạc Hà's islands who came north for the Coiled Root Hall and a war, and is the loudest voice in its mess against the sect he was born under. At the Cold Ford market he broke the fingers of a Thúy Vi tinker's boy for a joke, and the lad has not held a hammer since; the Root Hall said nothing.

people.role: Patrol captain of the pine-sea roads
people.appearance: Tests every bowstring against his puckered left ear before he trusts it.
people.backstory: Born across the Ngư Ca border in Lạc Hà's Hoa Khê Thôn, he came over as a boy when a toll quarrel burned his family's mill; he keeps the pine-sea roads open with Tuần Tùng Đường's wardens and teaches the Root Hall's boys to shoot. He leaves the slowest boy of each class at the Cold Ford butts overnight; Lạc Trường Cung (lac_truong_cung) will not speak of his night.

ties.note: the other captain
Tuần Tùng's head
the Tuần Tùng girl from his village
young inner disciple of the Coiled Root Hall; a bowyer's son

people.role: Ferry captain of the River Hall at Cổ Độ
people.appearance: Her laugh carries across the river; passengers grip the rail when she brings the ferry round.
people.backstory: A ferry captain of Cổ Độ and Đàm Thanh Giang's (dam_thanh_giang) cousin; she runs the River Hall's boats on the southern river and tells every passenger that the head once rowed this one. A coin flipped on the gunwale decides who boards the last crossing, and twice it left Hoàng Đê Sinh's (hoang_de_sinh) mother on the quay.

ties.note: her niece and disciple
her nephew and disciple; ferry boy of the Đàm family at Cổ Độ

people.role: Flood warden of the River Hall
people.appearance: Carries a flood-mark rod and leans on it only when he thinks no one is watching.
people.backstory: Born on the dike of Hà Đê Thôn in a flood year, he walks the River Hall's dikes every spring with a flood-mark rod and has never let a breach stand overnight. He signs Thải Chi's dike contracts with Ông Khổ Sâm (ong_kho_sam) each autumn, and pays the valley's office for the orphans' days, never the children.

ties.note: his son and disciple
sluice keeper of the River Hall's lower gates at Đào Thanh Thành
Thải Chi's steward; they sign the orphans' dike contracts together each autumn

people.role: The River Hall's man at Lãng Đào Môn
people.appearance: Stoops as if still bent over a gold-washer's pan; people say he walks like a man looking for something dropped.
people.backstory: The River Hall's man at Lãng Đào Môn; he was on the Đào Sa landing when Lạc Hà burned the ferries in 1173 (A080) and fished nails out of the river with the gold-washers for a year after.

ties.note: Lãng Đào's head
the ferryman's boy who fished the nails beside him, and went to Lạc Hà
Lãng Đào's heir at the gate

people.role: The Lake Hall's pearl tallier at Hàm Nguyệt Trang
people.appearance: A tally-cord wound round her wrist; she counts the people in a room before she speaks.
people.backstory: Born in Băng Tâm's Tiều Lộ Thôn and carried over the border in a famine winter, she is the Lake Hall's pearl tallier, posted at Hàm Nguyệt Trang to count what Kiều Nguyệt Châu (kieu_nguyet_chau) owes the palace; the manor's numbers have never once matched hers.

ties.note: the manor's numbers
the Hàm Nguyệt ledger-keeper; forty years of numbers that do not match
outer disciple at the Lake Hall; dives for the pearl count

people.role: Lake Hall inner disciple
people.appearance: One bright ribbon in an otherwise plain braid; she smells of lamp-oil and lake fish.
people.backstory: A lamp-fisher's daughter from Ngư Đăng Thôn whose Wood crossed the inner gate's line with nothing to spare; she sends her brother in the outer gate half of every allowance.

ties.note: her younger brother
outer disciple from the reindeer herders of Tuyết Lộc

people.role: First hand of the Array Hall, Cận Tùng Hàn's chosen successor
people.appearance: A narrow-faced woman who draws array lines in the air with one finger while she talks.
people.backstory: From Cận Tùng Hàn's (can_tung_han) own boat-builders' town, she is the best array hand in the palace after him and the one he means to leave the hall to. She wants to be asked. Nhiếp Cô Tân (nhiep_co_tan) has asked her something else instead: he wants a crossing laid on the river-mouth ice, and she is laying it out flag by flag in the Array Hall's back room. She brings every flag to Cận to check, as she has brought him everything since she was a girl.
people.wants: To be asked to lay a road that holds one person, not a patrol, and to be left the hall without having to use it.
people.secret: She lays the river-mouth crossing flag by flag exactly as Cận Tùng Hàn retunes it, marking each flag in a private sign to learn which breaks first; Tạ Chuẩn Thằng (ta_chuan_thang) has seen the signs and means to tell Nhiếp.

ties.note: means to leave her the hall, and has not said so; he checks every flag she makes
has asked her for a crossing on the ice
Array Hall inner disciple; lays the sluice wards at Đào Thanh

tree.targets_note: Pine route, then Earth's Nine Palaces and Gatehouse: array power from an Earth start, the Array Hall's line under Cận Tùng Hàn.

people.role: Array Hall inner disciple
people.appearance: One shoe always untied, and go-stone chalk follows him about like weather.
people.backstory: From Lạc Thạch Thôn, where Hàn Thạch's avalanche survivors went (V042), he is Cận Tùng Hàn's (can_tung_han) go partner more than his student, and he lays arrays only after he has lost a game.

people.role: Incense maker at Lãnh Hương Viện
people.appearance: Agarwood smoke clings to her so thickly that the palace cats trail after.
people.backstory: She grinds the resin and agarwood for the palace's sticks at Lãnh Hương Viện and can tell from the smoke alone whether Lịch Hương Trầm (lich_huong_tram) mixed them or she did.

ties.note: her daughter and disciple

people.role: The Tide Rite's only disciple
people.appearance: Repeats every instruction under his breath, twice, and still asks again; his stammer eases only near water.
people.backstory: Bạc Hải Âm's (bac_hai_am) only disciple at the Tide Rite; he knows his master means to walk into the sea on the day he can hold the tide alone, and he is learning it very slowly.

build.note: Outside method (R5): the Tide Rite's tide canon from Vọng Triều Các.

people.role: Pill Room inner disciple
people.appearance: Fringe singed short; she hums the same three notes at the first furnace.
people.backstory: A herb-carrier's daughter from Hạc Quy Thôn in the Pivot's hills who works the Pill Room's first furnace beside Đàm Thanh Giang (dam_thanh_giang) and teases him about his winter frost-roots. When furnace time ran late she threw out Mai Tiểu Phục's (mai_tieu_phuc) fever pills, and the girl lay sick three days longer.

ties.note: Pill Room inner disciple; keeps the only chimney under the canopy

people.role: Resin clerk in Tùng Gian Thành
people.appearance: Tilts his ledger away from anyone passing, thumb gilded with resin.
people.backstory: A merchant's son from the Pivot's city of Khai Dương who came north for the resin trade, he is Từ Tích Cốc's (tu_tich_coc) clerk in Tùng Gian Thành. His own side lots are cut with pine-pitch and sold to the palace, so Mẫn Lục Yên's (man_luc_yen) incense burns a breath short; his master pretends not to see.

ties.note: old outer disciple; weighs resin at Tùng Gian Thành
granary clerk of the steward's office at Lâm Hạ Trấn

people.role: Fence-walker of the grey pine vein
people.appearance: Chalks a mark on his wrist at every fence post, as he has seen the surveyors do.
people.backstory: Born on the Pivot's side of the border in Lộc Uyển Thôn, he walks the grey pine vein's fence for Tân Mặc Bách (tan_mac_bach) and has made friends, against orders, with Ân Lăng Thạch (an_lang_thach), the Thiên Cơ Hall's stone-cutter, who comes to the fence to look at the steles.

ties.note: fence-walker of the grey pine vein; counts Thiên Xu's surveyors

people.role: Warden of the malachite mine of Thạch Lục Khoáng
people.appearance: Malachite dust has turned his beard green at the roots.
people.backstory: Warden of the malachite mine, where stone is dug only where no pine must be cut (A051); a Metal-born miner's son whose Wood passed the inner gate's line by one point.

ties.note: his nephew and disciple
root-listener at the malachite mine; says where a gallery may be dug

people.role: The envoy's disciple; a survivor of Đoạn Vân Viện
people.appearance: A composed woman with a white streak in her hair from the night the cliff fell.
people.backstory: She was eight when the earthquake broke the cliff-cut halls of Đoạn Vân Viện in 1134 (V052), and she walked to the pines with eleven other survivors. Chử Lan Giang (chu_lan_giang) took her in and taught her to pour tea before she speaks. She goes back to the broken cliff every spring, alone, because a voice there still answers when she calls names into the rubble. She has not told anyone that it answers in her mother's voice.
people.wants: To hear her mother's voice answer a name that is not hers, and to know what the rubble says.
people.secret: She writes the names the cliff answers to on flat pebbles and buries three each spring under the green pines with Hứa Niệm Tùng (hua_niem_tung), so the dead of Đoạn Vân Viện have a roll of their own.

ties.note: took her in 1134

tree.targets_note: Pine route, then Bamboo Flute and Evergreen: soul and status resistance for an envoy's disciple who survived Đoạn Vân Viện.

people.role: The Coiled Root Hall's man at Tuần Tùng Đường
people.appearance: His smile arrives a moment after everyone else's has gone.
people.backstory: A caravan guard's son from the Pivot's Bích Khê Trấn and the Coiled Root Hall's man at Tuần Tùng Đường, riding the caravan roads with Hứa Vãn Cung's (hua_van_cung) wardens since the wolf winter of 1190 (A064). He tells Phượng Minh smugglers which night the wardens ride, for a share, and last autumn it cost Lạc Tùng Lang (lac_tung_lang) an arm.

ties.note: another Bích Khê man, at Tuần Tùng

people.role: Thôi Khinh Hồng's last disciple and only attendant at the retreat
people.appearance: A grey-haired woman in an apron, who sweeps pine needles off the retreat's steps three times a day and sits on the top one between sweeps.
people.backstory: A lake fisher's girl from Hồ Khẩu Thôn, as Thôi Khinh Hồng (thoi_khinh_hong) once was, she was taken in 1100 as the old woman's last disciple and has kept her retreat at Thính Đào Nhãn ever since. She is 140, still Trúc Cơ, and does not mind. She makes the tea, sweeps the needles, and watches Thôi practise the Startled Goose Step at dawn. After a hundred years she cannot do its first step.
people.wants: To see her master take one step of the Startled Goose without a cough.
people.secret: She waters the retreat's youngest pine with her own tea each night, and it has begun to answer her; she has told no one, least of all Thôi Khinh Hồng, who has listened five hundred years for it.

ties.note: her master and her whole life
pours his tea when he comes down each month

tree.targets_note: Her master's pine, then Bamboo Grove's evasion and Weeping Willow's heals: the attendant who keeps up with a goose's step.

people.role: Letter-carrier to the vassals
people.appearance: Sleeps with the satchel in his arms like a child with a doll.
people.backstory: A rope-maker's son from Lạc Hà's Tang Ma Thành, whose family wove the bridges Tùng Đào cut in 1174 (A202); he carries Chử Lan Giang's (chu_lan_giang) letters to the seven vassals and knows every ferry, inn and dog on the roads. He kept Thải Chi's grain-ship notice back a day until Ông Khổ Sâm (ong_kho_sam) paid his 'road money', and the dike children's grain came late.

ties.note: Lạc Hà's rope steward at Tang Ma, who rewove the bridges his family first wove
outer disciple; carries the palace's letters to the vassals
envoy's rider to Lãng Đào Môn and Tuần Tùng Đường

people.role: Woodcarver who mends the palace halls
people.appearance: Hums to the grain while he carves, and stops when watched.
people.backstory: A woodcarver of the Lâm clan of Lộc Minh, whose ancestors made a hall's beams from one fallen pine (A059); he mends the palace with fallen wood only, and his cousin Lâm Dã Hạc (lam_da_hac) went loose rather than sit the outer gate.

ties.note: went loose
a girl of his clan, and his disciple
outer disciple; the woodcarver's second apprentice
carter of fallen timber for the palace woodcarver (servant)

people.role: The first elder's go-between in the market
people.appearance: Counts you with her eyes, the way a market woman counts coin.
people.backstory: Phù Liên Kiều's (phu_lien_kieu) elder sister, who carries the first elder's money to her brother's go-between in the market and his letters back, and tells their mother he is apprenticed to a resin buyer. She sells copies of Hồ Tùng Nguyệt's (ho_tung_nguyet) letters to Giáp Lệ Hàn (giap_le_han), so the Root Hall reads each request before the boy can answer it.

ties.note: her brother in Thúy Vi's outer gate
outer disciple; carries letters at the Tùng Hạ Thị market

people.role: Vi Thanh Âm's disciple
people.appearance: Walks as if carrying a full bowl, even when her hands are empty.
people.backstory: From Thủ Mộ Thôn, the village that keeps the forest graves, she is Vi Thanh Âm's (vi_thanh_am) only disciple and carries her zither, and she has noticed that it is heavier than a zither should be.

people.role: Tùng Đào's man at Sương Tùng Các
people.appearance: Birch-bark curls cling to his clothes wherever he goes.
people.backstory: Born under Sương Tùng Các's high pines, he makes the birch-bark and resin paper the talisman house writes its wards on (V007); a ward is the only art Tùng Đào lets be written.

ties.note: Sương Tùng's head
the Sương Tùng elder he argues about resin with
inner disciple of the paper road; carries the pavilion's paper to the palace

people.role: The River Hall's steward at Đào Sa Thị; owes her life to a ma đạo fugitive
people.appearance: A sun-darkened woman with gold dust in the creases of her knuckles and a red thread tied round one wrist.
people.backstory: A gold-washer's girl of Đào Sa Thị, she was sixteen in 1092 when a hurt woman in a red robe came out of the reeds and washed sand beside her for two years (A079). The woman pulled her out of the river in the spring flood of 1093. She learned afterwards that it was Triệu Huyết Y (trieu_huyet_y), whom the righteous sects had hunted with Thôi Khinh Hồng (thoi_khinh_hong) (C024). She is the River Hall's steward at Đào Sa now, and Triệu still writes to her.
people.wants: To repay the red-robed woman's debt in a coin Triệu Huyết Y cannot refuse.
people.secret: She hides a hurt ma-đạo man in the Đào Sa reed beds, as the woman once hid her, and feeds him on the gold-washers' rice; Ông Khổ Sâm (ong_kho_sam) has noticed missing sacks and thinks they went to the dikes.

ties.note: pulled her out of the flood in 1093
the Thải Chi steward at Đào Sa
the Lãng Đào gold-washer at Đào Sa
the demonic girl she tells the story to
her nephew; she asked Triệu Huyết Y to save him, and regrets it every year

tree.targets_note: Pine route from Water, then the Black Abyss: deep linh lực for the River Hall's steward.

people.role: Lake Hall inner disciple; the loudest voice for a Water gate
people.appearance: A big-shouldered woman in an ice-cutter's leather apron who speaks to elders as if they were across a frozen lake, and never sits out a whole council.
people.backstory: From Tạc Băng Thôn, where the lake people cut ice for summer, she crossed the inner gate's Wood test at forty-five exactly and has spent ninety years saying the test is wrong. Half the lake's Water-born children stop at the outer gate because their Wood is thin, and she wants the Rain on the Pine Sea canon taught to them as an inner method. Thiều Lăng Ba (thieu_lang_ba) agrees with her and tells her to be quieter. She will not be.
people.wants: A Water inner gate at Noãn Ốc, taught the Rain on the Pine Sea canon.
people.secret: She teaches the canon's first verse to the lake children at the ice-cutting, which is forbidden; Úc Hàm Ba (uc_ham_ba) holds the lamp.

ties.note: agrees with her, quietly
another lake girl who crossed by a point
the steward who keeps the Wood test
outer disciple of the Lake Hall who failed the Wood test twice
Lake Hall inner disciple who passed the Wood test by one point

tree.targets_note: Pine route from Water, then the Rolling Waves idea: Water damage, the Lake Hall's voice for a Water gate.

people.role: Rope-hand of the Coiled Root Hall; held the windlass line on the last Ngư Ca bridge in 1174
people.appearance: Rope-burn lines run across both palms; he coils any cord he picks up without noticing.
people.backstory: He held the windlass line on the Tùng Đào bank the night Nhiếp Thừa Phong (nhiep_thua_phong) cut the last Ngư Ca bridge in 1174, and has never said whose rope parted first. In spring 1199 he crossed to the Lạc Hà bank on Nhiếp Cô Tân's (nhiep_co_tan) unsigned word to see how the new bridge was hung, and did not return; the roll carries him on long patrol.

ties.note: sent him over the Ngư Ca bank without the head's leave
his captain on the bridges, dead on the last one in 1174
asks after him at the Ngư Ca ferries
his gaoler; asks him each new moon who held the ropes on the last bridge
